name: Clock probe: a 2 s periodic damage aura ticks on game time over 30 s
contract: Curse of Agony rank 10 (47864) in the installed Spell.dbc is an instant SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE of 41 per
tick with EffectAmplitude 2000 ms and SpellDuration 24000 ms, with no SPELL_ATTR5 flags, so it neither starts
ticking at application nor scales its period with haste: it ticks at 2, 4, ..., 24 s after application, 12
ticks. AuraEffect::Update carries each diff's remainder into the periodic timer and caps ticks at
GetTotalTicks, so tick times follow game time to within one map update. spell_warl_curse_of_agony only scales
tick amounts (half, full, one and a half), all positive, so spell_damage_count sees every tick; spell hit
rating removes the application miss. Checkpoints 7, 13, 19 and 30 s of game time after the cast each lie 1 s
from the nearest tick and must read 3, 6, 9 and 12, and the curse has expired at 30 s. A 25 ms world step moves
a tick by at most one step; aura time that lags or leads fast-forwarded game time changes the counts.
